{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 0.50

|arg= global

|eff= local

|gr1= Interaction

|descr= [[File:setUserActionText.jpg|right|350px]] Changes user added action (see [[addAction]]) menu item text. <br><br>

|s1= object [[setUserActionText]] [actionIndex, textMenu, textWindowBackground, textWindowForeground]

|p1= object: [[Object]] - object the action is added to

|p2= actionIndex: [[Number]] - action id returned by [[addAction]]

|p3= textMenu: [[String]] or [[Structured Text]] - text title shown in scroll action menu

|p4= textWindowBackground: [[String]] or [[Structured Text]] - (Optional, default "") background text
|p4since= arma3 1.62

|p5= textWindowForeground: [[String]] or [[Structured Text]] - (Optional, default "") foreground text
|p5since= arma3 1.62

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>
_id = player addAction ["Hello", ""];
player setUserActionText [_id, "Good Bye"];
</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>
_id = billboard addAction ["Some Action", {}];
billboard setUserActionText [
	_id, 
	"Some Action", 
	"<t color='#ff0000'>Background-----------------</t><br>Multiline<br>Multiline<br>Multiline<br>. . .", 
	"<t color='#00ff00'>-----------------Foreground</t>"
];
</sqf>

|seealso= [[actionIDs]] [[actionParams]] [[addAction]] [[inGameUISetEventHandler]] [[showHUD]] [[inputAction]] [[removeAction]] [[removeAllActions]] [[action]]
}}
